# HARCHOY

> HARCHOY is a premium bespoke suit manufacturer and authorized fabric agent offering white-label OEM/ODM/OBM solutions for tailoring studios and corporate clients worldwide. Founded in 2020, with 20,000+ suits produced annually and DDP delivery to 50+ countries. Alibaba International 5-Star Supplier and #1 Menswear Store.

## Solutions
- [Bespoke Partner Program](https://www.harchoy.com/solutions/bespoke-partner.html): White-label OEM suit manufacturing for tailoring studios and ateliers. Your labels, your branding, our craftsmanship.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.harchoy.com/solutions/enterprise.html): Corporate attire consultancy + customization for global enterprises: brand-first method, the three questions, the 10-step process, 50-piece MOQ, DDP delivery.

## Products
- [Product Catalog](https://www.harchoy.com/products.html): Bespoke suits, dress shirts, blazers, overcoats, womenswear and corporate attire. OEM manufacturing for global brands.
- [Premium Fabrics](https://www.harchoy.com/fabrics.html): Authorized agent for Loro Piana, NISHIOKA Orimono wool and premium textiles. Cashmere, wool and blended fabrics.

## Manufacturing
- [Our Process](https://www.harchoy.com/process.html): From sketch to suit — the complete bespoke manufacturing journey including measurement, cutting, sewing and quality control.
- [Supply Chain](https://www.harchoy.com/supply-chain.html): DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) delivery to 50+ countries. Complete logistics with zero hidden costs.
- [Factory Live](https://www.harchoy.com/factory-live/): Live view of our self-owned production facility.

## Journal
- [Property & Facility Team Uniforms: One Identity Across Every Role](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/property-facility-uniforms.html): Property attire as one design system across concierge, security, cleaning, maintenance, and management — portfolio consistency via central spec, per-garment QC, 50-piece pilots.
- [Healthcare & Clinic Uniforms: Dressing Patient-Facing Teams as a Brand](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/healthcare-clinic-uniforms.html): Healthcare attire as a trust signal: one design system for reception, patient services, administration, and management — hygiene-friendly fabrics, multi-location consistency, 50-piece pilots.
- [Metro, Airport & Transit Uniforms: Dressing Teams That Serve Millions](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/transit-uniforms-metro-airport.html): Transit attire as one design system with role variants — station staff, drivers, security, maintenance, management — durable fabrics, consistency at scale, 50-piece pilots.
- [Brand-First Corporate Attire: Start With the Brand, Not the Garment](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/brand-first-corporate-attire.html): The brand-first inversion for corporate attire: answer who wears it, where, and who it is shown to before designing garments — color system, silhouette, details, rollout.
- [Importing Suits from China to the EU: Duties, HS Codes & DDP in 2026](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/importing-suits-china-eu-duties.html): EU suit import costs explained: HS heading 6203, typical duty of around 12%, import VAT, EORI and paperwork, and how DDP delivery makes the landed price fixed.
- [Suit Quality Inspection: The 10-Point QC Checklist We Use on Every Order](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/10-point-qc-checklist.html): The 10-point per-garment inspection behind every HARCHOY order: measurements vs. spec, fabric, pattern matching, stitching, shape, collar, trims, finishing, pressing, final review.
- [How Long Does a Custom Suit Order Take? Real Timelines from Design to Delivery](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/real-timelines-sketch-to-delivery.html): Stage-by-stage lead times for custom suit and uniform orders: 72-hour design proposal, sampling, 15–20 day bulk production, express delivery from 3 days, DDP to 50+ countries.
- [Hotel & Hospitality Uniforms: Dressing Front-of-House as a Brand Experience](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/hotel-uniforms-brand-experience.html): How hotels design role-based uniforms — concierge, front desk, F&B, housekeeping — as one consistent brand experience, with fabric and rollout guidance.
- [Your Team Is a Walking Billboard: Uniforms as Brand Touchpoints](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/uniforms-as-brand-touchpoints.html): Why team attire is the most repeated brand touchpoint a company owns, and how to design uniforms as a walking brand symbol on purpose.
- [What Does a Corporate Uniform Program Cost?](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/corporate-uniform-program-cost.html): The five cost factors of a corporate attire program — fabric, construction, quantity, branding details, logistics — and how to budget.
- [From Brand Brief to Team Uniform: The 10-Step Process](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/corporate-attire-10-step-process.html): The 10-step corporate attire program: brand research, design, sampling, sizing, production, QC, DDP delivery and team photography.
- [Why Most Corporate Uniforms Fail](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/why-corporate-uniforms-fail.html): The 3-question framework (who wears it, where, for whom) that turns corporate attire into a walking brand symbol.
- [How to Start a White-Label Suit Brand](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/start-white-label-suit-brand.html): Six-step playbook for launching a suit label with an OEM partner — no factory required.
- [How to Choose a Bespoke Suit Manufacturer](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/how-to-choose-bespoke-suit-manufacturer.html): 7 essential questions every tailor shop should ask when choosing an OEM bespoke suit manufacturer.
- [Bespoke Suit MOQ Explained](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/moq-explained.html): Minimum order quantities in bespoke suit manufacturing — why 50 pieces is the practical entry point for tailoring studios.
- [DDP Shipping Guide](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/ddp-shipping-guide.html): Complete guide to Delivered Duty Paid shipping for bespoke suit imports.
- [Wool Fabric Guide for Bespoke Suits](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/wool-fabric-guide-bespoke-suits.html): Understanding wool fabrics — super numbers, weight, weave and origin.
- [White-Label Tailoring Business](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/white-label-tailoring-business.html): How to build and scale a white-label tailoring business with OEM partners.
- [Premium Fabric Supply Chain](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/premium-fabric-supply-chain.html): Inside the premium fabric supply chain — from cashmere goat farming to finished cloth.
- [From Sketch to Suit](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/from-sketch-to-suit-manufacturing-journey.html): The complete manufacturing journey of a bespoke suit.
- [Hidden Costs of Bespoke Imports](https://www.harchoy.com/blog/blog-2026-06-02-hidden-costs-bespoke-import.html): How to avoid hidden costs when importing bespoke suits internationally.
